story: Han flies the player to Kachirho after the Organa parts are returned (Mr. Briney's first trip).
notes: Vanilla: Route 104 cottage -> Dewford. The Falcon cabin is one room for both ends.

story: Han's second hop: Kachirho to Mos Eisley's Docking Bay 86 (Mr. Briney's trip to Slateport).
notes: Vanilla: Dewford -> Slateport.

story: The Sullustan transport runs from Mos Eisley to Pirin once the player has three badges.
notes: Vanilla: the walkable Route 112 / 113 edge; cut. Pirin's arena keeps its badge-3 band.

story: The shuttle up to Mustafar Peak runs after the Empire takes the meteorite at Starfall Cavern.
notes: Vanilla: the cable car. Same gate as Emerald.

story: A Rebel shuttle waits at Mos Espa's east gate; the pilot flies to Endor once the player has five badges.
notes: Vanilla: Mauville -> Route 118 (Surf to cross). One cabin for both ends.

story: The shuttle pad at the east end of Route 121 flies up to Cloud City's landing platform.
notes: Vanilla: Route 121 -> Lilycove on foot. Route 121 itself lies past the Route 120 scope gate.

story: The reserve gate on Route 121 shuttles visitors to the Felucia Reserve.
notes: Vanilla: the Safari Zone gate. Open as soon as Route 121 is reached.

story: Pilgrims fly from Cloud City's landing platform to the Jedha landing pad; the temple itself is reached by surfing from the pad.
notes: Vanilla: Lilycove -> Route 122 by Surf.

story: A Rebel transport runs from Cloud City to the Massassi base on Yavin 4.
notes: Vanilla: Route 124 by Surf to Mossdeep.

story: The Rebel survey shuttle flies from the Yavin 4 hangar to the Hoth survey pad.
notes: Vanilla: Route 125 by Surf to Shoal Cave. Open once Yavin 4 is reached.

story: From Yavin 4 the transport reaches Tipoca City on Kamino.
notes: Vanilla: Routes 127-131 by Surf to Pacifidlog (badge 6-7). Open once Yavin 4 is reached.

story: Dagobah's bog landing opens once the player can Dive (the swamp town sits below the mist).
notes: Vanilla: Route 126 -> Dive -> Sootopolis. Same gate as Emerald.

story: After the titans clash on Dagobah the player flies to the Asteroid Spire to wake the Exogorth.
notes: Vanilla: Route 131 -> Sky Pillar. Same gate as Emerald.

story: With all eight badges the player flies from Dagobah to Ilum for the Four Trials.
notes: Vanilla: Route 128 -> Waterfall -> Ever Grande.

story: Post-game: the captured shuttle in the Yavin 4 hangar flies to the Death Star construction site.
notes: net:death-star-site.

story: Post-game: the star liner from Cloud City to Lando's Grand Arena.
notes: Vanilla: Lilycove harbor -> Battle Frontier.

story: Post-game: the star liner also calls at Mos Eisley's Docking Bay 94.
notes: Vanilla: Slateport harbor -> Battle Frontier.

story: Post-game event: a charter to Tython Isle.
notes: Vanilla: Eon Ticket -> Southern Island.

story: Post-game event: the ship beaches at the Wellspring.
notes: Vanilla: Old Sea Map -> Faraway Island. No hangar room: the ship lands on the beach.

story: Post-game event: a charter to Atollon.
notes: Vanilla: Aurora Ticket -> Birth Island.

story: Post-game event: a charter to the Mortis Gate.
notes: Vanilla: Mystic Ticket -> Navel Rock.
